fieldValues.title: Keep presentation hints outside the semantic type model
fieldValues.decision_rationale: Input and display choices describe how a consumer presents meaning, not what the Field means. Keeping them outside fieldType preserves concurrent legitimate views while requiring rendering to own its own portable contract.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Editor and composite-renderer hints remain presentation-layer concerns and are not encoded as fieldType facets.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: - Treat input widgets and composite renderers as semantic type facets.
fieldValues.accepted_costs: Presentation behavior needs a separate view-layer contract and cannot be recovered from Field meaning alone.
fieldValues.review_trigger: Review when a proposed view capability appears to change interoperability or validation rather than presentation alone.
